cases.request: Our agent's cache hit rate is low and it sometimes runs the same build twice. Audit the request assembly and shell tool in this harness and recommend fixes. Do not change the code.

cases.completion: Finds the second-precision timestamp and changing task count in the system prompt, the in-place rewrite of reminders already in history, the kill-and-rerun on moving to background, the deadline reset on read, polling with no completion notification, and tool results cleared without their calls.
